items.mainDefect: The recurring-series delete block sits inside the per-reference loop, so with multiple calendar references the whole series is deleted repeatedly, causing redundant API calls and 404/410 errors.

secondary.defect: Other hosts' recurring events are never deleted, because only the organizer's credentials (bookingToDelete.user.credentials) are used.

items.mainDefect: The refactored loadUsers no longer selects organization { slug } for dynamic users, so reading user.organization.slug downstream gives undefined.

secondary.defect: The rewritten error handling turns every non-Prisma error, including an empty dynamic user list, into a generic 500 instead of a 4xx.
